description: Get the audio file address for a recitation. With an ayah it returns that ayah (when the reciter has verse-by-verse recordings); without an ayah it returns the full surah file. Use list_reciters for reciter ids.

ayah.description: ayah number inside the surah; leave out for the whole surah

format.description: mp3 or ogg; default is the best available

reciter.description: reciter id from list_reciters, for example ar.alafasy

name: get_audio_url
